111:t_1:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I see. So it's finally happened...」

111:t_1:5.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Unfortunately, our current forces couldn't stop $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s descent.」

111:t_1:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$オットー$$, what's the situation?」

111:t_1:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「We just received word from Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$.」

111:t_1:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「She says the $$ネオ・ジオン$$ forces that descended have seized $$ピーターソン基地$$.」

111:t_1:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So it's $$ピーターソン$$...」

111:t_1:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It's not a large base, but the $$νガンダム$$ has been brought there.」

111:t_1:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It was passed from one jurisdiction to another, so even we had trouble tracking it down. We finally got a lead the other day.」

111:t_1:14.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I sent Warrant Officer $$チェーン$$. It should have returned to service once the paperwork was done, but now this has happened...」

111:t_1:15.en:
$$オットー$$
「I can only call it bad luck.」

111:t_1:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$アムロ$$... Is something worrying you?」

111:t_1:18.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...No. If we go to $$ピーターソン$$, the answer will become clear.」

111:t_1:19.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are you saying we should retake that base?」

111:t_1:20.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I agree. We should attack $$ネオ・ジオン$$ before it establishes its position and uncover its intentions at the same time.」

111:t_1:21.en:
$$オットー$$
「It's true we'll fall further behind with each passing day...」

111:t_1:22.en:
$$オットー$$
「Commander $$ブライト$$, we'll head to $$ピーターソン$$ and retake the base from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

111:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I understand. I'm counting on you, Captain $$オットー$$.」

111:t_1:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the $$νガンダム$$... If this isn't a coincidence, we need to be on our guard...)

111:t_1:29.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...$$タクヤ$$. Is the $$リ・ガズィ$$'s maintenance done?」

111:t_1:30.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It's complete. Crew Chief $$ジョナ$$ has checked it too.」

111:t_1:32.en:
$n
「Will you go to recover the $$νガンダム$$ yourself, Captain?」

111:t_1:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...The $$リ・ガズィ$$ is best suited to breaking through the enemy lines.」

111:t_1:34.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But even so, for you to go alone...」

111:t_1:35.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll leave covering me to all of you. Still, that makes me a failure as the mobile unit's commander.」

111:t_1:36.en:
$n
「...I'm a little surprised. I didn't realize you were so attached to the $$νガンダム$$, Captain $$アムロ$$...」

111:t_1:38.en:
$n
「Ah... I'm sorry... It's just... I thought you were more detached about mobile suits, Captain...」

111:t_1:39.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're right, $n. Mobile suits are weapons... tools, so to speak. I don't intend to get more attached than necessary.」

111:t_1:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm going to get the $$νガンダム$$ simply because I need a useful tool.」

111:t_1:41.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...That's how I would have answered before, but now it's a little different.」

111:t_1:42.en:
$n
「Do you mean you've changed the way you think?」

111:t_1:43.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I still believe mobile suits are tools...」

111:t_1:44.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But there's a theory that humanity evolved from archaic humans because we used tools and fire.」

111:t_1:46.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe humanity is in a similar period of transition now.」

111:t_1:47.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Are you saying tools... mobile suits can make people evolve?」

111:t_1:48.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...The $$Ｚガンダム$$ turns human will into power, and the $$ダブルオーライザー$$ uses its $$ＧＮドライヴ$$s to encourage awakening as an $$イノベイター$$...」

111:t_1:49.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And there's your $$ユニコーン$$... Seeing machines like these makes me think that way.」

111:t_1:50.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A $$ガンダム$$ can... make people evolve...」

111:t_1:52.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's just my fantasy. Don't think too deeply about it.」

111:t_1:53.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But on that day... amid the radiance of $$時空修復$$, I saw a light in the $$νガンダム$$.」

111:t_1:54.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I intend to pilot that machine again so I can find out what it was.」

111:t_1:55.en:
$n
「I understand, Captain. I'll give you all the support I can.」

111:t_1:56.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「$n, did Captain $$アムロ$$'s explanation convince you?」

111:t_1:57.en:
$n
「You saw the light during $$時空修復$$ too, didn't you?」

111:t_1:59.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I think it was a power that could change something. I want to believe in it too.」

111:t_1:60.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Thanks, $$バナージ$$, and you too, $n.」

111:t_1:61.en:
$n
「N-no... I'm sorry for what I said earlier. It was rude.」

111:t_1:62.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's fine. ...I understand why you said it too.」

111:t_1:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's the same as me putting my faith in the $$νガンダム$$. Come to terms with the $$スフィア$$ within yourself.」

111:t_1:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Don't just say you'll try. Show me you can do it.」

111:t_1:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That's right, $n. There must be something beyond fear, anxiety, anger, hatred, and sorrow...)

111:t_1:74.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「So this is the $$ガンダム$$ at the center of the phenomenon that stopped $$アクシズ$$ from falling...」

111:t_1:75.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Damn it... If this machine hadn't been there, the world the Colonel would lead could have become a reality.」

111:t_1:77.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Shall we use it as an aggressor and shoot it down spectacularly to make an example of it?」

111:t_1:78.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「We could also remodel it in $$ジオン$$ style and use it to hunt the Federation remnants.」

111:t_1:79.en:
$$チェーン$$
「Are you... fighting out of personal grudges?」

111:t_1:80.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「It seems you don't understand your position.」

111:t_1:81.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「You have no freedom. We haven't locked you up only because you're a technical officer.」

111:t_1:82.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I won't allow you to lay a hand on a prisoner.」

111:t_1:85.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「I've been entrusted with sole command of this unit, including deciding what happens to this $$ガンダム$$.」

111:t_1:86.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Stand down. That's an order.」

111:t_1:87.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「Even if it was a farce, we highly appreciate your skill in seizing a Federation base, Commander.」

111:t_1:88.en:
$$ネオ・ジオン兵$$
「We'll be watching how you handle things, Commander $$ギュネイ$$.」

kept_omissions: 111:t_1:34: Banagher leaves his objection to Amuro going alone unfinished; Amuro answers with support plan.
